game_title: Type Cast Forge – Geyser Flats Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats, erupting geyser flats: the lava scout must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats: erupting geyser flats
core_gameplay_loop: In Geyser Flats, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about forge_heat to power up the lava scout and open the forge anvil.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Cast Forge' (Week 2 slot 8), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Geyser Flats'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Geyser Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 6.
